esp32_tts_init.message0: initialize offline TTS %1 model %2 I2S BCLK %3 LRCLK %4 DOUT %5 MCLK %6
esp32_tts_init.tooltip: Create ESP32-S3 offline Chinese TTS and I2S output; use -1 when MCLK is not connected

esp32_tts_speak.tooltip: Block while synthesizing UTF-8 Chinese to the configured I2S output

esp32_tts_speak_pinyin.tooltip: Speak space-separated pinyin with tone digits 0 through 5, such as da4 jia1 hao3

esp32_tts_speak_money.message0: offline TTS %1 speak amount yuan %2 jiao %3 fen %4 mode %5
esp32_tts_speak_money.tooltip: Synthesize a nonnegative amount; jiao and fen must be from 0 through 9

esp32_tts_get_speed.tooltip: Return the current speech speed from 0 through 5

esp32_tts_is_ready.tooltip: Check whether the TTS engine initialized successfully

esp32_tts_is_speaking.tooltip: Check whether TTS is synthesizing and outputting speech

esp32_tts_last_error.tooltip: Return the latest numeric error code; 0 means no error

esp32_tts_last_error_message.tooltip: Return the English description of the latest error

esp32_tts_stop.tooltip: Request that the current blocking speech stop from another FreeRTOS task

esp32_tts_end.tooltip: Release the TTS engine resources so it can be initialized again
